movement.description: True only for requested player travel between locations, including unresolved destinations. False for observations, item interactions without travel, and negated or hypothetical movement. A portable item is not a destination.

text.description: First extract the complete destination phrase. If a place is specified along with a direction, use the place: 'Head north towards the Great Forest' targets 'the Great Forest', not 'north'. Preserve unresolved references.

kind.description: named: specified destination by name or type, taking priority over a direction. back: retracing; relative: outside/inside; directional: direction or route without a destination; exploratory: open-ended travel, possibly within a named area rather than to a specified destination; reference: there/him.

target.description: Null only when movement is false.
